answer: Each new agent locks a 3,000 POA tundra bond, frozen for 30 epochs. A mirror check compares every new agent's answers against all others from the same epoch; two identities whose wording or timing track each other too closely are flagged, and a flagged pair forfeits both bonds. Grading weight unlocks on a terrace schedule: each step up needs 10 more epochs of passed work. So 50 fake identities freeze 150,000 POA for months, earn almost no weight early, and every caught pair burns 6,000 POA.
